# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the EXACT tasks you broke/fixed) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 (seed child) — 100% infra-blocked (temperature 400); NO edit shipped
- Changes I made: NONE. `prompt.md` left byte-for-byte unchanged.
- Why no edit: All 50/50 val rollouts fail with the identical API-layer error
  `litellm.BadRequestError 400: 'temperature' does not support 0.0 with azure/gpt-5.5
  (only default 1 supported)`. Verified all 50 traces have output=null, tool_calls=[],
  tokens=«redacted» — the model NEVER processed the system prompt. The only editable artifact is
  prompt.md (system prompt), which cannot influence the request's `temperature` field.
  So no prompt edit can pass VERIFIED (failure is independent of prompt text) and every
  re-score under the unchanged config is 0.000 → gate rejects any change as net-zero.
  Shipping speculative prompt text here is the forbidden "cosmetic padding".
- Building on prior RESULTS: none exist (seed baseline; LEDGER/RUNMAP empty).
- Refuted hypotheses (proven this iteration, do NOT re-test): "a system-prompt edit can
  raise the score" is FALSE while the temperature config is broken — the prompt is never
  evaluated, so prompt content has zero effect on the 0.000 score.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: none are capability clusters — there is ZERO
  capability signal. The single blocker is a harness/model-config bug.
- Plateau signal: the run is CONFIG-BLOCKED, not prompt-blocked. No lever in the
  system-prompt edit space can move it. REQUIRED external fix: stop sending
  `temperature:0.0` to azure/gpt-5.5 — set it to 1 / omit it / special-case the model /
  add a model-group fallback. Until then every candidate (incl. baseline) scores 0.000.
- Focus next iteration: if (and only if) the temperature config is fixed and real
  rollouts appear, diagnose actual capability clusters in ./trajectories/ and edit
  prompt.md then. Do NOT churn prompt.md while rollouts remain infra-errored.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** REJECTED (champion unchanged) · val=0.000 Δ=+0.000 · fixed={—} · broke={—}. — its WHOLE batch was reverted; re-introduce only the edits that did NOT break a task above, dropping/redesigning the ones that did.

## Iteration cand_0002 (seed child) — STILL 100% infra-blocked (temperature 400); NO edit shipped
- Changes I made: NONE. `prompt.md` left byte-for-byte unchanged (identical to seed).
- Why no edit: This iteration's `./trajectories/` are the SAME failure as cand_0001 — all
  50/50 val rollouts fail with `litellm.BadRequestError 400: 'temperature' does not support
  0.0 with azure/gpt-5.5 (only default 1 supported)`. Verified programmatically: 50/50
  match the temperature error, 50/50 have `output=null`, 0/50 have tool_calls, 0/50 have
  tokens>0. Each task's score.feedback literally says "Infrastructure error, not a prompt
  defect; do not optimize against it." The model never consumes the system prompt, so no
  `prompt.md` edit can pass VERIFIED (failure is independent of prompt text) and none can
  move the 0.000 score → the gate rejects any change as net-zero. Speculative prompt text
  = forbidden cosmetic padding, and would risk a regression once real signal appears.
- Building on prior RESULTS: cand_0001 RESULT = REJECTED, val=0.000, broke={} fixed={} —
  it also shipped no edit under this same block. I did NOT re-try any prompt churn because
  cand_0001 already proved (and this iteration re-confirms) prompt content has zero effect
  while the temperature config is broken.
- Refuted hypotheses (do NOT re-test): "a system-prompt edit can raise the score" is FALSE
  while temperature:0.0 is sent to azure/gpt-5.5 — the prompt is never evaluated.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: NONE are capability clusters. There is zero
  capability signal; the single blocker is a harness/model-config bug.
- Plateau signal: CONFIG-BLOCKED, not prompt-blocked — flat 0.000 across cand_0001 and
  cand_0002. No lever in the system-prompt edit space can move it. REQUIRED external fix:
  stop sending `temperature:0.0` to azure/gpt-5.5 (set to 1 / omit / special-case / add a
  model-group fallback). Until then every candidate incl. baseline scores 0.000.
- Focus next iteration: ONLY after the temperature config is fixed and non-null rollouts
  appear — diagnose real capability clusters in `./trajectories/` and edit `prompt.md`
  then. Do NOT churn `prompt.md` while rollouts remain infra-errored.
